name: list_commits
description: List commits from a branch or starting ref in an Origin-hosted repository, optionally filtered by lists of exact git author or committer emails, by inclusive since and until bounds on committer time, and by a repository path as git log -- <path> does without --follow. A commit matches a list when its email equals any listed email, and must match every list, bound, and path that is given. A directory path matches when any descendant changes. A filtered page can be short while nextPageToken is present, and is empty with nextPageToken only after 100,000 commits were searched without a match. Keep paging to reach older matches. Each item is sha, full message, author, committer, parents, and tree. Omits patches. Continuation calls reuse the filters stored in pageToken.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

authorEmails.description: Only commits whose git author email equals any listed email, case-insensitive. Not names or partial matches. At most 100 distinct emails.

committerEmails.description: Only commits whose git committer email equals any listed email, case-insensitive. At most 100 distinct emails. Combined with authorEmails, a commit must match both lists.

since.description: Only commits whose git committer time is at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp, such as 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z. The bound is inclusive and uses committer time, which a rebase or cherry-pick rewrites, not author time.

until.description: Only commits whose git committer time is at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp, such as 2026-08-31T23:59:59Z. The bound is inclusive. Combined with since and the email filters, a commit must match every filter that is set.

path.description: Only commits that change this repository path, as git log -- <path> does without --follow. A directory matches when any descendant changes. Leading and trailing slashes and surrounding whitespace are ignored. Combined with email and time filters, a commit must match every filter that is set.
